 The Cabinet makes the following Regulations under Section 62 of the Environmental
 Management and Climate Change Act 2020:

 1 Citation
 These Regulations may be cited as the Environmental Management and Climate
 Change (Notices) Regulations 2021.

 2 Commencement
 These Regulations come into effect on the day they are notified in the Gazette.

 3 Precautionary Notice
 For the purposes of Section 43 of the Act, an authorised officer may issue a
 Precautionary Notice in Form 1 of the Schedule.

 4 Notice to Cease
 For the purposes of Section 44 of the Act, the Secretary may issue a Notice to
 Cease an act or activity in Form 2 of the Schedule.

 5 Notice to Improve
 For the purposes of Section 45 of the Act, an authorised officer may issue a
 Notice to Improve in Form 3 of the Schedule.

 6 Prohibition Notice
 For the purposes of Section 46 of the Act, the Secretary may issue a Prohibition
 Notice in Form 4 of the Schedule.
